sofia: FYI new onboard run for ranklight-v2-int8 showed a surprising drop vs fp16 baseline: NDCG@10 -3.2%, MRR -6.1%. Putting logs here for quick triage.
liam: ugh. did the tokenization pipeline change for this build?
sofia: I think so. quick diff of tokenizer config: `pad_token` switched from '<pad>' (id 1) to '' (id 0) when we applied the small tokenizer update. didn't catch it in model conversion.
maya: that could shift KV cache alignment if padding trimming behavior also changed. any repro commands?
sofia: repro used eval harness:
```bash
python -m eval_harness.run --model ranklight-v2-int8 --dataset longtail-100k --seed 42 --batch 256 --trim_padded_inputs True
```
sofia: baseline (fp16) run: NDCG@10=0.432, MRR=0.261
sofia: new int8 run: NDCG@10=0.418, MRR=0.245
aj: not huge numbers but consistent gap. do we see this on short queries vs long docs?
sofia: gap concentrated on short queries (<16 tokens) and on examples where candidate text had trailing whitespace / HTML tags.
eva: can you paste a tokenization example side-by-side?
sofia: sure:
`"How to reset?"` -> fp16 tokenizer: [`▁How`, `▁to`, `▁reset`, `?`]
`"How to reset?` (with trailing space) -> new tokenizer: [`▁How`, `▁to`, `▁reset`, `?`, '']  // pad token appended rather than trimmed
liam: that extra pad token will change attention masks, kv offsets, and therefore scores for short queries.
aj: also check `tokenizer.pad_token_id` and `model.config.pad_token_id` parity. If they mismatch, loss/score masking might be wrong in eval.
sofia: confirmed: tokenizer.pad_token_id = 0, model.config.pad_token_id = 1 on the converted int8 artifact.
eva: oof. conversion pipeline should have propagated pad id. looks like the quant conversion script overwrote some tokenizer fields.
aj: quick mitigation: run eval with `--trim_padded_inputs False` and set explicit `--pad_token_id 1` in harness to see if gap closes.
sofia: ran that: new int8 (force pad_id=1, no trim) -> NDCG@10=0.431, MRR=0.258 (mostly recovered).
liam: good sign. so root cause is pad id mismatch + default trimming.
ops-bot: deploy note: affected artifact ranklight-v2-int8 v2026-03-18 was built with conversion script conv_v2.9. Flagging build for rollback if customers on Dedicated see regression.
sofia: plan: 1) add tokenizer sanity check to conversion (pad_token parity), 2) re-run model conversion with corrected tokenizer, 3) add a small regression test in eval harness for short-query cohort.
maya: for the conversion test add a tiny snippet: `assert tokenizer.pad_token_id == model.config.pad_token_id` and also sample `encode(" ", add_special_tokens=False)` returns pad behavior expected.
aj: also audit any code paths that set `trim_padded_inputs` default. We changed default to True in batcher around Feb and that combined with pad mismatch caused this.
eva: for long term, add a kvcache unit test: feed sequence with trailing pad token and ensure cached keys reused the same offsets as fp16 runtime.
liam: do we need a canary re-deploy for prod? the recovery looks near parity but maybe run a shadow benchmark on Dedicated for one day.
sofia: agreed. I'm kicking off a canary shadow run across two slices (short queries, trailing-whitespace cohort). will post results.
aj: thanks. dropping a tiny patch to conv script now. patch: `if tokenizer.pad_token_id != model.config.pad_token_id: model.config.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id`
eva: pls also add a warning log so future conversions flag this in CI.
sofia: doing that. ping me if you want the failing sample list, I'll share the CSV.
liam: thanks all — great catch. :thumbsup:
